description: This Java source file defines an immutable class `HeaderBasedPlaceholderSubstitutionAlgorithm` responsible for substituting placeholders within input strings based on headers encapsulated in `DittoHeaders`. It provides methods for creating instances with custom replacement definitions and for performing the substitution operation, throwing an exception if unknown placeholders are encountered.

classes.name: HeaderBasedPlaceholderSubstitutionAlgorithm
classes.description: An immutable class that manages placeholder replacements based on DittoHeaders, providing functionality to instantiate with custom mappings and perform placeholder substitution within input strings.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance with specified replacement definitions.

methods.name: substitute (String, WithDittoHeaders)
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in the input string using headers from the given WithDittoHeaders object.

methods.name: substitute (String, DittoHeaders)
methods.description: Performs placeholder substitution directly given a DittoHeaders object.

methods.name: createReplacerFunction
methods.description: Creates a function to resolve placeholders with the given DittoHeaders, throwing an exception for unknown placeholders.
